h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ambala

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ambala

items.pText: Ambala sits on the Haryana and Punjab border, and its weather swings further than most buyers expect. Summers are hot and dry, while winter brings cold mornings and thick fog across the plains. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for Ambala's schools, housing societies, cantonment-area colonies and parks. We build it at our Vasai factory, about 1,280 km away, and send it by road for installation by our team or a dealer.

That range of weather matters when you decide where the playground goes. In December and January children want to play in the sun, and in May they need shade. A spot under tall trees that lose some leaves in winter works well for both. Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts are weather-proof, and the plastic slides and seats feel far less cold to the touch on a foggy morning than bare metal does. We ask for photos taken at different times of day if you are unsure about sun and shade.

richText.heading: Placing a playground for Ambala's winters and summers

c: Look at your site twice, once on a winter afternoon and once in summer. The best place gets sun after lunch in winter and shade in the hottest months. Slides should face away from the western sun.
Fog and dew leave slides and seats wet in the early hours, so a quick wipe before school playtime helps. Rubber flooring is less slippery than tiles when damp. Roto-moulded

items.q: Is plastic playground equipment comfortable to use in cold weather?
items.a: Yes. Roto-moulded plastic slides and seats do not get as cold to the touch as bare metal. Wipe off dew or fog moisture in the morning before children start playing.

items.q: Where should we place the playground on our school ground?
items.a: Where it gets winter sun in the afternoon and some shade in summer, away from roads and parking. Send us photos of a few possible spots and we will suggest one on the layout drawing.

items.q: Do you deliver and install playground equipment in Ambala?
items.a: Yes. We make everything at our Vasai factory, send it to Ambala by road and install it with our own team or a dealer, grouted or self-standing depending on your ground.
